name: print-social-black-poster-with-violet-light-beam-and-create-pill
title: Black poster with a glowing pill button emitting a violet light beam over a faint grid
whatItIs: A black portrait with a faint line grid, a glass pill with a plus and 'Create' from which a violet light beam fans out to the right, the words 'Brand Intelligence' in the beam and tiny credits and handle in the corners.
whatItMeans: Futuristic and focused; a button emitting light suggests creation as a power.
techniques: Turn a UI pill into a light source.
Fan a coloured beam across the frame.

vocabulary.definition: An interface button as a graphic.
A subtle line grid in the background.
